_comment: SPARK — S167: atlas specs for the six TIER-9 BOSS TOWERS, THREE conditions each.
⭐ THE CASTLE / TIER-3-TOWER PATTERN, DELIBERATELY. A tower is a STRUCTURE with conditions, not a
character with actions: framesPerState 1, fit 'box', every state a `still` PNG rather than a clip.
A building has no gait, no swing and no idle bob, so a clip would spend veo's budget re-drawing a
static subject and buy back two failure modes this pipeline has already paid for twice (seed drift
over the length of a clip, and outright generation failure).
⚠ THREE STATES, NOT THE TIER-3 FOUR. The tier-3 towers carry a `spawning` frame; these do not,
because the art the owner approved is intact / damaged / destroyed and nothing else was drawn.
⛔ AND `spawning` WOULD BE UNREACHABLE ANYWAY: `t3TowerAtlasBase` has ZERO renderer consumers in
src/ — grep it — so the tier-3 tower art has never been drawn at all. Adding a fourth state here
would be authoring a frame for a code path that does not exist.
⭐ fit 'box', NOT 'height'. Height-fit exists to keep CHARACTERS comparable by how tall they look.
These six are deliberately different shapes — an upright coffin, a WIDE LOW hellmouth that is not a
tower at all, a squat mastaba — and box-fit keeps each one whole inside its cell instead of scaling
a wide ground feature down by its width.
⚠ normaliseStateScale is NOT set and must not be. It equalises the SEED-FRAME size across states,
which is right when clips of one character disagree about zoom. These are three separate DRAWINGS
of a building in different conditions, and a destroyed tower is SUPPOSED to be smaller than an
intact one — normalising would inflate the rubble back to full height. The demons entry is the
case that proves it: owner ruling, the hellmouth CLOSES as it is destroyed.
⚠ cellW/cellH 256 matches the tier-3 towers exactly, so the two tiers sit at one scale on the board.
_white_limit: ⛔ enclosedWhiteLimitPct 4e-05, SET EXPLICITLY, and the omission is the whole hazard.
build-sprite-atlas.mjs's DEFAULT is 0.003 — 75x more permissive. The tier-3 tower and castle specs
never set the knob at all, took that default, and shipped opaque near-white background pockets that
the owner spotted by eye in S165: "some of them have that white background because not cut out too
well". The cause was an OMISSION, not a tuning error, which is why it is written here rather than
left to the default a second time.
⭐ AN AGGRESSIVE LIMIT IS SAFER ON A STRUCTURE THAN ON A CHARACTER. Enclosed near-white below the
limit is deliberately KEPT — that is what saves a character's eyes and blade glints — but the
sharedStyle for these six already forbids anything white or near-white ON the building, so by
construction every near-white pocket in one of these frames is background.
